technique_name: Describe the difference between an artificial neural network and a GPT model.
description: An artificial neural network (ANN) is a computing system that is structured like a human brain. It uses multiple layers of neurons and connections between the neurons to solve complex tasks through learning from its environment. A GPT model, on the other hand, is a type of natural language processing model that is trained on a large corpus of text and relies on set language rules to generate its output.
